g.title: Fan Blades and Rotor Hub: Four light blue-gray blades with curved profile and small notch near tip, riveted to central hub behind guard
Motor Housing: Gray cylindrical housing directly behind blade hub, partially occluded by guard and blades, connecting to pedestal neck
Pedestal Base and Mount: Flared blue-gray pedestal with flanged circular foot on cream display block, with visible mounting screws and small toggle on side
Central Hub Medallion: Circular red badge with silver script monogram GE at exact center of blade assembly
Wire Guard Cage: Large spherical open cage of concentric wire rings and bent wire supports surrounding blades, visible in sharp focus in foreground
Internal Electric Motor and Wiring: Not directly visible; inferred from presence of enclosed housing and fan typology as an electric fan, no cord or internals visible in this frontal view
